Interested in this property? Sign up for mySherryFitz to arrange your viewing, see current offers, or make your own offer. Register now at SherryFitz.ie.

Versatile Investment & Residential opportunity with potentially 5 income streams. This exceptional property offers incredible flexibility for investors, hospitality operators, or private buyers. Currently utilised for the hospitality trade, the main layout features four spacious en-suite bedrooms, a communal kitchen/dining area, and a welcoming reception room. Additionally, the property includes a self-contained, own-door one-bedroom apartment. 

Key Opportunities:
1. High-Yield Investment: Perfectly designed for a co-living or shared rental model, capable of generating five separate income streams.
2.Hospitality Venture: Ready to operate immediately as a boutique bed and breakfast or guesthouse.
3.Owner-Occupier + Income: Ideal as a private primary residence, using the rental income from the one-bedroom apartment to substantially offset running costs.
4.Private Family Home: Easily reconfigured into a single, substantial residential dwelling featuring a private, enclosed backyard.
